ir.name: pairwise_logistic_advantage_weighted_loss_safe
ir.intuition: Pairwise logistic loss weighted by sigmoid-normalized advantage gap, clamping inputs for numerical stability.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch.get('advantage_gap', zeros)
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
adv_weight = sigmoid(adv_gap)
margin = lpw - lpl
loss = -logsigmoid(clamp(margin, -20, 20)) * adv_weight * weight
return mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    zeros = ops.zeros_like(lpw)
    adv_gap = batch.get('advantage_gap', zeros)
    adv_weight = ops.sigmoid(adv_gap)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_clamped = ops.clamp(margin, -20.0, 20.0)
    logistic_loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(margin_clamped))
    loss = ops.mul(logistic_loss, adv_weight)
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
